Since AC=BC, CD/AC=sin40°/sin80°. Now in triangle ACD, with ∠ACD=40° and the side ratio CD/AC matching the ratio for angles 40° and 100°, conclude ∠CAD=40°. Therefore ∠BAD=∠BAC+∠CAD=80°+40°=120°.
